project.name: nablatensor-quant
project.description: The book: composable Monte-Carlo model step blocks (GBM, Heston, SABR, local-vol, Hull-White 1F, LMM), a payoff vocabulary (European / Asian / lookback / barrier / digital / cliquet / autocallable / FX / quanto / basket / caps-swaptions / Bermudan shell), the MonteCarlo and MultiOutput drivers, variance-reduction hooks, a curve bootstrap with analytic Jacobian, and an adjoint-gradient Calibrator (L-BFGS and Levenberg-Marquardt).
